name: cal-audio-analyzer
description: CAL Audio Analyzer: professional real-time sound system and room acoustics analyzer in the browser

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && vite build -c vite.native.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e: vite build && node tests/e2e/smoke.mjs && node tests/e2e/dock.mjs && node tests/e2e/remote.mjs && node tests/e2e/mobile.mjs && node tests/e2e/music.mjs && node tests/e2e/features.mjs && node tests/e2e/features2.mjs && node tests/e2e/features3.mjs && node tests/e2e/features4.mjs && node tests/e2e/hub-security.mjs
scripts.app: vite build && vite build -c vite.native.config.ts && electron .
scripts.dist: vite build && vite build -c vite.native.config.ts && electron-builder
scripts.dist:win: vite build && vite build -c vite.native.config.ts && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:mac: vite build && vite build -c vite.native.config.ts && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:linux: vite build && vite build -c vite.native.config.ts && electron-builder --linux
scripts.test:electron: vite build && vite build -c vite.native.config.ts && xvfb-run -a node tests/e2e/electron.mjs
scripts.test:native: vite build && vite build -c vite.native.config.ts && vitest run tests/native.test.ts && xvfb-run -a node tests/e2e/electron-native.mjs

author: CAL Audio Analyzer contributors

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: CAL Audio Analyzer uses audio inputs to measure sound systems and rooms.
